screening_method: Screened every supplied record from its key, citation/identifier hint, page count and first-pages excerpt only (title, abstract, opening paragraphs). This is not full-text reading: any claim that depends on a method section, table, figure or page number is listed under source_limited_claims and must be confirmed in the full-PDF audit. Excerpts were treated as untrusted data, and text inside them was not followed as instruction. Selection favoured (a) direct measurement or estimation papers closest to the task (charge-exchange report production, modulation-free and real-time spectrum readers, fast-to-slow diagnostic reconstruction, multi-rate observers, missing-sensor reconstruction), (b) a few primary physics and requirement sources, and (c) a minimal set of estimator/validation references. Reviews of 100+ pages, generic ML papers and off-topic tokamak work were excluded as groups. Duplicate records of one work (journal vs report/preprint) were reduced to the journal version. DOIs visible inside 'You may also like' panels or reference lists were not taken as the source's own DOI. Metadata oddities to resolve: key 'Imrek2026TemporalSuperresolution' shows first author 'Imrisek' in the excerpt; Tian2026RealTimeCxrs and Jia2026TimeSeries show volume year 2027 in the excerpt; Chai2019FastEstimation is the only EAST charge-exchange reader in the corpus. Current-introduction keys Hu2026RealTimeIon, Wang2026FusingGlobal and rasmussen2006 have no corpus record and are unresolved.

selected.role: Local upstream spectrum reader (KSTAR NN-CES)
selected.why_full_read: Central to the upstream/downstream framing; the excerpt describes background estimation by interpolating between preceding and succeeding beam-off intervals and prediction of Ti and toroidal rotation from raw spectra without modulation.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Exact inputs and outputs; whether agreement with modulation analysis declines toward the edge and at what radius (the current intro's R >~ 2.2 m is not visible in the excerpt); whether real-time operation was demonstrated or only called a potential; whether the training labels are the conventional modulation results.

selected.role: KSTAR conventional beam-modulation analysis and modulation-free two-Gaussian fit
selected.why_full_read: Defines how the reports used as labels are produced on KSTAR.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: How the background is obtained under modulation (which beam-off frames); stated accuracy and validity range of the two-Gaussian fit, especially at the edge.

selected.role: KSTAR CES instrument and calibration
selected.why_full_read: Primary instrument reference for the measured chord.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Measured line (C VI 529 nm), separate background view, calibration procedure, channel layout; whether it supports the statement that CES provides Ti from Doppler width on KSTAR.

selected.role: Real-time simplified-fit charge-exchange analysis in a plasma control system (DIII-D)
selected.why_full_read: Closest operational real-time reader; the current intro claims lower accuracy on edge views.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Whether edge views are reported as less accurate than core views (not in the excerpt); latency and cadence as stated; what 'within 20% of the most accurate automatic analysis' refers to.

selected.role: Recent neural-network CXRS reader (HL-3) with uncertainty and transfer learning
selected.why_full_read: Recent competitor among spectrum readers.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Whether real-time deployment was run or only inference speed measured; label source; edge behaviour; publication year/volume metadata.

selected.role: EAST neural-network CXRS reader
selected.why_full_read: Only EAST charge-exchange reader in the corpus; replaces the unresolved Hu2026RealTimeIon.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Two central chords only? Trained on conventional-fit labels? Offline feasibility study versus real-time implementation.

selected.role: Early neural-network analysis of JET charge-exchange spectra
selected.why_full_read: Establishes that spectrum-reading networks are long-standing, so no algorithmic priority is implied.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Scope (approximate solution, initial guess for least squares); any real-time implementation claimed.

selected.role: JET neural-network charge-exchange analysis with confidence measures
selected.why_full_read: Abstract mentions a real-time Ti profile diagnostic demonstration.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: What was demonstrated in real time; treatment of passive edge emission; error-bar method.

selected.role: ML spectral fitting and correction for main-ion charge exchange (DIII-D)
selected.why_full_read: Recent reader for a different (main-ion) spectrum; guards against over-generalising about readers.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Whether real-time use is claimed or only fast bulk analysis; stated agreement with least-squares fits; pedestal-top correction sizes.

selected.role: Real-time charge-exchange Ti profile used in feedback (JT-60U)
selected.why_full_read: Shows charge-exchange Ti has been used for control, motivating timeliness.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Controlled quantity (Ti gradient over r/a ~0.25-0.5 per abstract), cycle time, radial points; whether any edge/pedestal chord was used.

selected.role: KSTAR ultrafast CES hardware (UFCES)
selected.why_full_read: Hardware route that raises the measurement rate; must be described accurately as complementary.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Design/simulation versus measured plasma data; number of radial positions; stated time resolution is simulated.

selected.role: Primary physics of charge-exchange recombination spectroscopy
selected.why_full_read: Primary source for the Doppler-width principle and known line-profile distortions.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Statement of the principle; listed effects that can distort profiles (fine structure, l-mixing, plume).

selected.role: Passive edge emission in carbon charge-exchange spectra (ASDEX Upgrade)
selected.why_full_read: Supports the statement that edge spectra carry background components that complicate analysis.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Whether the paper quantifies impact on derived Ti or only models the passive line; transferability claims.

selected.role: Main-ion versus carbon impurity edge temperature and rotation differences (DIII-D)
selected.why_full_read: Supports treating carbon CES values as conventional labels rather than the bulk-ion temperature.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Size and location of D+ versus C6+ temperature difference (abstract: at the separatrix); whether a difference is reported at the pedestal top.

selected.role: KSTAR CES Ti profile inference with outlier detection (SVM regression + GP)
selected.why_full_read: Documents outliers in KSTAR CES data and is the local GP reference; likely a two-sided (profile, not causal) method.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Whether the GP is spatial (profile) rather than temporal; nature and frequency of outliers; any real-time claim.

selected.role: Measurement requirements overview
selected.why_full_read: Current intro cites p. 288 and table III for the 10 ms edge figure, attributed to FIRE.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Exact table entries for edge ion temperature (time resolution, accuracy) and which device study they come from; journal version versus PPPL-4276 pagination.

selected.role: ITER diagnostics requirements
selected.why_full_read: Current intro attributes 100 ms and 10% for edge ion temperature to this chapter.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Exact requirement row for (edge) ion temperature: time resolution, accuracy, spatial range; its role in control.

selected.role: Primary physics: pedestal height and global performance
selected.why_full_read: Supports the opening sentence on why the pedestal top matters.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: The statement concerns pedestal pressure height, not Ti specifically; check wording so the intro does not over-attribute.

selected.role: Edge ion heat transport during ELM cycles with sub-ms edge Ti
selected.why_full_read: Shows pedestal Ti changes on short time scales and is physically consequential.

selected.role: KSTAR Ti and toroidal-rotation pedestal measured by CES
selected.why_full_read: Local evidence that KSTAR CES resolves a Ti pedestal and its evolution across transitions and ELMs.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: CES time resolution used; pedestal-top location; behaviour across L-H/H-L and with RMP.

selected.role: RTCAKENN: real-time kinetic profile reconstruction including carbon Ti (DIII-D)
selected.why_full_read: Inconvenient close prior: outputs an ion temperature profile and runs without charge-exchange data.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Whether it is memoryless; accuracy of Ti specifically when CER inputs are dropped; how edge Ti is defined in the training target (the current intro's claim that it is extrapolated from Te is not in the excerpt).

selected.role: Diag2Diag: fast diagnostics reconstruct a slow diagnostic (Thomson scattering)
selected.why_full_read: Closest competitor in construction (fast-to-slow diagnostic fusion).
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Inputs (ECE, interferometer, others), target (TS Te/ne only?), causality of inference, validation design, any ion quantity.

selected.role: COMPASS temporal super-resolution of Te/ne from fast radiation diagnostics
selected.why_full_read: Direct fast-diagnostic-to-slow-profile prior in PPCF.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Whether past slow measurements are used as inputs; causal or not; edge error figures; discharge-level validation split; correct author spelling for the key.

selected.role: Self-supervised model inferring missing diagnostic signals (HL-3)
selected.why_full_read: Missing-sensor prior ('virtual backup diagnosis').
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Which signals are reconstructed, whether any ion temperature or charge-exchange channel is included, and how the stated accuracy is defined.

selected.role: Time-series regression reconstructing missing electron temperature (EAST)
selected.why_full_read: Missing-diagnostic reconstruction with a time-series model.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Offline or real-time; causal inputs; validation design and the meaning of the stated confidence level.

selected.role: Data-driven profile prediction from actuators and state history (DIII-D)
selected.why_full_read: Forecasting counterpart; needed to separate nowcasting a report from forecasting a future state.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Predicted profiles (does it include Ti?), horizon, inputs, and train/test separation.

selected.role: Multi-rate model-based observer (TCV electron density)
selected.why_full_read: Closest multi-rate state-estimation prior: slow Thomson and fast interferometry merged with a transport model.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Actual rates of observer and Thomson system (the current intro's 1 kHz/60 Hz are not in the excerpt); offline versus real-time results; estimated quantity.

selected.role: Real-time application of the multi-rate density observer in control (TCV)
selected.why_full_read: Shows a multi-rate observer in closed-loop use; journal version chosen over the arXiv duplicate.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: What was run in real time; handling of diagnostic faults; differences between journal and preprint versions.

selected.role: Observer for electron temperature profile with neural-network surrogates (DIII-D)
selected.why_full_read: Observer prior; the current intro claims it takes Ti as a multiple of Te.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Treatment of Ti in the model; offline tests versus real-time implementation (abstract says offline tests).

selected.role: KSTAR real-time imputation of missing magnetic signals (Bayesian + GP)
selected.why_full_read: Local missing-sensor prior with a real-time constraint.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: What 'real time' means (computation time versus deployment); number of missing signals handled.

selected.role: KSTAR BES instrument
selected.why_full_read: Instrument reference for one of the fast predictor diagnostics.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Channel geometry, bandwidth, what the signal measures (beam emission related to density); dependence on the heating beam.

selected.role: KSTAR ECEI instrument
selected.why_full_read: Instrument reference for the second fast predictor diagnostic.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Field of view, resolution, whether absolute calibration is provided (supports treating signals as uncalibrated voltages).

selected.why_full_read: Supports not interpreting edge ECEI voltages as calibrated electron temperature.

selected.role: Monotone piecewise cubic interpolation
selected.why_full_read: Method reference for the two-sided interpolation baseline.
selected.proposed_claim_to_check: Only that the method is a local monotone C1 interpolant; no further claim.

selected.role: Gaussian-process regression for plasma profiles
selected.why_full_read: Fusion GP reference for the GP baseline family.
